subject: Recap: unit-cost targets & host comparison — Medius discovery
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medius.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: unit-cost targets & host comparison — Medius discovery

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + next steps so we have a clear pricing baseline for the internal team: 

1) Confirmed token volume profile (approx):
   - Training/ingest + prompt traffic: ~12M tokens/day (peaks to ~20M)
   - Generation (responses to users): ~6M tokens/day
   - Monthly aggregated estimate: ~540M tokens/month

2) Medius target unit economics and budget context:
   - Desired target: $/1M tokens between $6–$9 (primary target $7.50)
   - Current internal budget range for inference: $4k–$8k/month initially, can expand with clear ROI and SLA

3) Price benchmarking (for quick reference on today's call):
   - OpenAI (gpt-4o-like hosted): ~$15–$22 per 1M tokens (varies by contract/commit)
   - Anthropic (Claude-style): ~$12–$18 per 1M tokens depending on volume and embedding use
   - Typical open-model hosts/self-managed (quantized): $4–$10 per 1M tokens depending on autoscaling and prefix caching

Notes on Redwood differentiation: we can often hit the $6–8 range for steady volumes with our batching + KV caching + reserved capacity guidance (Dedicated) and push lower with private + quantization for sustained traffic patterns.

Attachments: I uploaded a short benchmarking summary and a starter estimate workbook (see attached).

Ask / next steps: 
- Could you confirm whether the 540M/mo estimate is realistic for Q4 planning? (yes/no with +/- 15% is fine)
- Is the $7.50/1M target a hard ceiling or a preferred target? If hard ceiling, flag and we'll sketch out the Dedicated vs Private split to show feasibility.
- Are there any procurement timelines or approval gates we should know about (SOW, finance review, procurement windows)?

I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik to prepare a tailored committed-capacity vs hosted comparison for that $6–9 target and return a clear recommendation and costs by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks —
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0184
--
Attachment stubs: medius-prod-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-benchmark-summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medius.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: unit-cost targets & host comparison — Medius discovery

Vivek —

Thanks for the detailed recap and for the quick turnaround on the workbook. Confirmations below: 

- Volume: 540M/mo is our current planning estimate for Q4. There's a chance marketing pilots in Oct push us to ~650M/mo, so +/- 20% is safe.
- Unit-price target: $7.50/1M is our preferred target; finance would be happier if we can get below $7, but not strictly a hard ceiling.
- Budget: initial monthly budget of $6k–$9k is our range for a first-phase deployment; we can expand if we have clear cost forecasts and latency SLAs.
- Procurement timeline: finance and procurement will start an RFP/PO review the week of Aug 10. We should plan a commercial packet before then.

A couple of clarifications:
- We will need an explanation of how caching affects the effective tokens billed (prefix caching, KV reuse) — is that something you can include in the next deck?
- Security: we will require SOC2 type II evidence and a short list of encryption/KMS options for Private deployment.

If you can send the committed vs hosted comparison + a short caching explainer and SOC2 evidence by EOD tomorrow that would be perfect.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Director of Product 
Medius Health
samantha.lee@medius.ai
+1 650-555-0199

On Wed, Jul 21, 2027 at 2:05 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> (see message above)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medius.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: unit-cost targets & host comparison — Medius discovery

Samantha —

Appreciate the quick confirmations and the timeline. We'll deliver the following by EOD tomorrow (internal owners noted):

- Committed vs hosted pricing comparison tuned to 540M / 650M monthly scenarios (owner: Marissa) — includes per-1M cost, expected latency ranges, and break-even commit levels.
- Short caching explainer (1 page) showing how prefix/KV caching can reduce billed tokens for your expected request patterns (owner: Karthik).
- SOC2 + security checklist and KMS options summary (owner: Marissa) — I'll attach the SOC2 evidence pack and outline Private options.

Internal note: Marissa/Karthik — please prioritize a scenario table that shows: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) vs Dedicated (1 GPU pool reserved) vs Private (quantized inference) with per-1M token effective price and estimated monthly invoice for both 540M and 650M. Include assumptions (avg prompt length, average response tokens, cache hit %. )

I'll also prepare a short narrative (1 page) we can hand to Medius procurement before Aug 10.

Thanks team —
Vivek
